newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks edge up on mixed sentiment.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks edge up on mixed sentiment.

text.p: Dhaka stocks closed marginally higher ahead of weekend as retail buying of low priced scrips helped offset losses by weighted stocks, brokers said.
The benchmark index of the Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) rose 1.13 points or 0.09 percent at 1,216.68 on a turnover of 83.1 million taka. Gainers led the losers by 83 to 54.
Singer Bangladesh lost 74.70 taka to 6,718.55 and Anwar Galvanizing Ltd rose 10.39 to 325.39.
